title: NuGetCooldown configuration
description: Configuration for NuGetCooldown (nuget-cooldown.json). Place next to your solution; the nearest file walking up from each project is used.

cooldownDays.description: Minimum age, in days, every resolved package version must have. Versions younger than this fail the check.

scope.description: Which packages are checked: 'all' (direct and transitive) or 'direct'.

allow.description: Packages exempt from the check. Each entry is 'IdPattern' (any version) or 'IdPattern@Version'; '*' is a wildcard, matching is case-insensitive. Examples: 'MyCompany.*', 'Serilog@4.3.0'.

sources.description: NuGet V3 service index URLs, queried in order. Defaults to nuget.org.

onUnknown.description: How to report a package whose publish date cannot be determined.

onUnlisted.description: How to report a package version that is unlisted (withdrawn) on its source.

onFeedError.description: How to report a source that could not be queried (network or server failure).
